note: Family campground (formerly Honey Bend Resort) minutes off I-55 exit 60 near Route 66, around four fishing ponds: pool, jumping pillow, pedal boats, putt-putt, game room, playgrounds, tent sites and cabins. Also rents monthly sites year-round to long-term workers. Gated: arrivals after 7 p.m. should call ahead. --Claude
